svg.desc: Zstandard decoding, in multiples of libzstd's speed: ahead on 11, level on 3, behind on 25 of 39 files; 0.92 to 1.09. Zstandard encoding: speed in multiples of libzstd's level 3, against compression ratio: 2 of stdx's 2 levels have a faster and smaller point: level 1 by libzstd 3; level 3 by libzstd 3.
svg.text: stdx's Zstandard against its baselines, on Neoverse-N2
One job of run 44677310424 at commit 0dd2e97. The line at 1 is the baseline each panel's title names; the axis is logarithmic.
Zstandard decoding, in multiples of libzstd's speed
ahead on 11, level on 3, behind on 25 of 39 files; 0.92 to 1.09
Zstandard encoding: speed in multiples of libzstd's level 3, against compression ratio
2 of stdx's 2 levels have a faster and smaller point: level 1 by libzstd 3; level 3 by libzstd 3
The number beside a point is its level. Up is smaller output, and right is faster.
† the benchmark repeats this file of 256 KiB or less, so the branch predictor learns it (decision 45)
